caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug with a handle, rendered in realistic style. The jug is primarily gray in color and features blue painted decorations. These decorations include floral and leaf motifs, with broad leaves and round flower shapes distributed symmetrically on the front and sides of the vessel. There is a band near the top, just below the jug’s rim, decorated with blue floral forms as well. Above the band, there is legible text inscribed into the jug's surface. The handle is attached from the upper neck to the shoulder and has blue lines accentuating its shape. The jug sits alone on a plain, light beige background with no other objects or distractions present. The composition centers the jug, with careful shading providing a lifelike sense of form and depth.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
